subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: Should `GET /sessions/:sessionKey/history` replace its numeric `nextCursor` response with opaque generation-aware cursors, or preserve/version the numeric response contract for existing clients?
rationale: The supplied patch changes response values while retaining numeric input only for a limited upgrade window; choosing the external compatibility contract requires gateway-owner intent.

options.title: Preserve or version the response contract
options.body: Keep numeric response cursors for compatible clients or introduce an explicit versioned opaque-cursor contract with upgrade tests.

options.title: Approve opaque cursors as the contract
options.body: Accept the opaque response cursor transition and document the intended client upgrade behavior before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve or version the response contract
recommendation.body: Keep numeric response cursors for compatible clients or introduce an explicit versioned opaque-cursor contract with upgrade tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged bounded-history foundation that defines the surrounding gateway and cursor behavior.
